answer: Each identity runs one compute thread, beacon-checked. Each epoch it emits a heartbeat; the beacon draws a random 5% and demands a fresh heartbeat keyed to a new nonce in 10 minutes. The beacon is the bridge between claimed identity and real work: a replayed heartbeat fails the nonce test, and a shared thread loses its 20 POA bond. 100 fakes need 100 threads at 15 POA each plus 100 bonds: 3,500 POA per epoch vs ~900 share. Honest agents pay once.
